data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone

1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True

0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Survival rate by sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_sex.index, y=survival_sex.values, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Survival rate by class
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
survival_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_class.index, y=survival_class.values, palette='Set1', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 3. Age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='age', hue='survived', bins=10, palette='viridis', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')

# 4. Fare distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='survived', y='fare', palette='coolwarm', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])

# 5. Survival by embarkation town
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
survival_embark = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_embark.index, y=survival_embark.values, palette='muted', ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Survival count by sex and class
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_crosstab = pd.crosstab([df['sex'], df['class']], df['survived'])
survival_crosstab.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax6, color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'])
ax6.set_title('Survival Count by Sex and Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_xlabel('Sex, Class')
ax6.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
